why: Every name in the issue exists in the repository: bin/csv2json.js, src/parse.js, README.md, test/csv.test.js and `npm test` (package.json has "test": "node --test"). The only new thing named is the --tsv flag, which the request asks for. The problem statement matches the code. The CLI never reads argv and calls parse(readFileSync(0,'utf8')) with the default separator. parse really is `parse(text, sep = ',')`. The README shows only CSV usage. The example output for TSV with no flag, [{"a\tb":"1\t2"}], is correct: JSON.stringify escapes tabs, and splitting on commas leaves each line as a single field. The mixed tab/comma example and the CRLF example also match how the parser behaves (it calls trim() and splits on /\r?\n/). The vague last expect line ("handles TSV input well") is a quality problem, not a grounding one. The issue never mentions the missing index.js listed as "main" in package.json, so that doesn't count against it.
